Name: NPC Clint Marriage 1.6
Author: muxuelaiyin
Description:
你好，这里是克林特可婚Mod的非官方1.6更新，授权由作者在评论区放出。

这个Mod将克林特变成一个可婚的NPC，并为他增加了新的肖像、行走图、大量的日常对话和婚后对话等等。详细介绍请前往原Mod介绍页面查看：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4230]Clint Marriage Mod[/url] 。

这次更新我主要是修复﻿了原Mod遗留下来的各种Bug，并将它完全由CP添加，以及大量的优化。

关于兼容性，克林特是原版NPC，涉及到修改他的Mod非常多，我无法让他与所有Mod兼容，你可以通过config配置来调整，如果有与其它Mod的严重冲突，请随时报告给我。
目前已知的不兼容：
[list]
[*]与季节性服饰不兼容，需要在配置中手动关闭克林特的美化，或者在这个Mod中选择不改变他的肖像。
[*]与其它拓展克林特对话的Mod不兼容，可能会发生互相覆盖。
[*]与其它克林特可婚Mod不兼容，但如果你在配置里选择关闭可婚选项，也许能互相兼容。
[/list]此外，和几个大型拓展：SVE、RSV、ES兼容（但东斯卡普有背景故事上的冲突），和NPC路西基尔兼容。

PS：
1.展示图中用到的高清肖像来自[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19380]Portraits of Clint Pam Willy[/url]，需要[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]作为前置，使用方法自行搜索。
2.﻿有任何问题请在此处或者XHS给我留言，我的XHS ID：沐雪来饮。我看到有空就会回。
3.如果你喜欢这个mod，请在下载完成15分钟后回到主界面给我点个赞，拜托拜托。
——————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
(Sorry, my English is not good, so I used software translation.)
This MOD contains English translation, and the text comes from the original MOD. My English is very poor, so I am only responsible for merging it into the i18n file. If there are any translation errors, please do not report them to me as I am unable to resolve them. If anyone wants to create a more accurate translation, feel free to do so.

A datable and marriagable Clint is now available for someone finding a new bachelor! For a more detailed introduction, please go to:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4230]Clint Marriage Mod[/url].

Currently known incompatibility:
[list]
[*]Not compatible with seasonal clothing, you need to manually turn off Clint's beautification in the configuration, or choose not to change his portrait in this Mod.
[*]Not compatible with other mods that expand Clint's dialogue, there may be mutual overlap.
[*]Not compatible with other Clint spousal mods, but if you choose to turn off the spousal option in the configuration, it may be compatible with each other.
[/list]In addition, it is compatible with several major expansions such as SVE, RSV, and ES (but there are conflicts in the background story of East Scap), and compatible with NPC Lucikiel.

﻿PS:
1.The portrait used in the display image comes from[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19380]Portraits of Clint Pam Willy[/url].
2. If you have any questions, please leave a message here or contact me on XHS. I will fix them when I have time, but please describe them in more detail because I am a bit inexperienced.﻿
3.  If you like this mod, please give me a like on the main interface after downloading it, please.
4. Anyone who wants to translate this mod into other languages is welcome, and I would be extremely grateful.
